terms.definitionEn: An array method that adds one or more items to the end of an array and returns the new length.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتضيف عنصر أو أكتر في آخر الـ array وبترجّع الطول الجديد.
terms.example:
const a = [1, 2];
a.push(3); // a is now [1, 2, 3]

terms.definitionEn: The numbered position of an item inside an array, starting from 0.
terms.definitionAr: رقم مكان العنصر جوه الـ array، وبيبدأ من 0.

questions.question: What does fruits.push('orange') do?
options: Adds 'orange' to the end of the array
Adds 'orange' to the start of the array
Removes the last item from the array
questions.explanation: push() adds items to the END of the array and changes the original array.
questions.explanationAr: push() بتضيف العنصر في آخر الـ array وبتغيّر الـ array الأصلي.

questions.explanation: pop() removes the last item (30) from the original array, then the array is printed.
questions.explanationAr: pop() بتشيل آخر عنصر (30) من الـ array الأصلي، وبعدين بتتطبع.

questions.explanation: After shift() q is [2, 3]; unshift(9) makes it [9, 2, 3], so length is 3 and q[0] is 9.
questions.explanationAr: بعد shift() بقت [2, 3]، وبعد unshift(9) بقت [9, 2, 3]، يعني الطول 3 وأول عنصر 9.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank so the code prints [ 1, 2, 3 ].
questions.explanation: push(3) appends 3 to the end of the array.

questions.prompt: Write a function lastItem(arr) that returns the last element of the array, or null if the array is empty.
questions.explanation: The last index is arr.length - 1. Check for an empty array first.

questions.question: What is the difference between push() and concat()?
keyPoints: push() mutates the original array; concat() returns a new array
push() returns the new length; concat() returns the new array
push() can add items one by one; concat() can merge whole arrays
questions.modelAnswer: push() changes the array it is called on and returns its new length. concat() leaves the original untouched and returns a new array that contains the merged items.
